WITH hw AS (
  SELECT m.id, m.date, m.home_team_api_id
  FROM "match" m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
),
latest AS (
  SELECT hw.id, hw.home_team_api_id, ta.buildupplayspeedclass,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hw.id ORDER BY ta.date DESC) rn
  FROM hw
  JOIN team_attributes ta ON ta.team_api_id = hw.home_team_api_id
   AND CAST(ta.date AS timestamp) <= CAST(hw.date AS timestamp)
),
fast AS (
  SELECT id, home_team_api_id FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND buildupplayspeedclass = 'Fast'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS home_wins FROM fast GROUP BY home_team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.home_team_api_id, c.home_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.home_wins DESC) rk FROM counts c
)

FROM ranked r
